per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The interface should enable 90% of novice users to complete key tasks (register, browse, pay, play) without assistance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Usability testing should be conducted with approximately 30 participants to validate a 90% success rate for key tasks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI should incorporate African art motifs to feel familiar and culturally relevant.
Routine UI responses should take no more than 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Credit-card payment processing should be confirmed within 15 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Initial buffering for video playback should not exceed 10 seconds, and rebuffering should be minimal.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Credit-card data should be protected with encryption, strict access controls, and PCI-DSS compliance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Tokenization should be preferred over storing full Primary Account Numbers (PANs).
Real-time alerts should be generated for suspicious activity such as failed logins, unusual payment declines, and brute-force attempts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Immediate out-of-hours alerts (SMS/on-call) should be generated for critical security events such as large spikes in failed payments, suspected card fraud patterns, DDoS-level traffic spikes, and repeated failed admin login attempts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The platform should have an uptime of 99.5% for public-facing services.
The admin console can have lower availability than customer-facing services.
The platform should support 100,000 registered users at launch.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall be capable of supporting 100 000 customers.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The platform should handle spikes in traffic without incurring huge fixed infrastructure costs, using auto-scaling with cost controls.
Audit logs should be maintained to trace who made changes in the admin console.
A formal incident response procedure should be defined, including first acknowledgement within a short window and a plan to restore or mitigate.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Formal testing (performance, usability, security) should be conducted before launch.
